_note: Public refusal records of ARC collected under docs/first-refusal-protocol.md. No records are currently present. Reserved for refusals of ARC only; Phase 0 calibration records about adjacent protocols do not enter this file. Reasons are stored verbatim because paraphrase would add an interpretation.
_consent_gate: This file is a public artifact. A record with visibility=private must be de-identified or explicitly consented BEFORE being committed here (protocol §6). Committing first and redacting later cannot un-publish the repository.

_schema.id: R1, R2, ... (real records are marked '*' in the fold's report)
_schema.actor: developer | company | merchant | user | community — attached by a human AFTER the reason is recorded (protocol §3.5)
_schema.exit: WAIT | DEFECT | FORK | REJECT — same later human step
_schema.reason: the participant's own words, verbatim and unedited
_schema.mechanism: a §4 candidate (4.1..4.6) ONLY if the participant volunteered it when asked the optional follow-up; 'none' if they said nothing would change the answer; never inferred from the reason text (protocol §3.3, §3.5)
_schema.waits_on: (WAIT only) what the participant is waiting on, in their words
_schema.waits_on_actor: (WAIT only, optional) the actor type waited on, when it is a specific side
_schema.source: github_issue | github_discussion | email | x_reply | reddit | conference | interview | ... (protocol §5)
_schema.date: YYYY-MM-DD — when the refusal was recorded
_schema.visibility: public | private — the participant's explicit consent state
_schema.stimulus: what the refuser actually saw before refusing: README | README-summary | email-pitch | GitHub-issue-thread | ... (protocol §5 — a refusal is a refusal OF something, and the something may not be ARC)
